Communication was great from the start. When I was first searching for landscaping quotes, I took a pause and told him I would be reaching out probably the next season. The next season came around and Michael reached back out to me to see if I was ready to move forward in a polite and non-pushy way. This told me he really cares about his business and ended up winning my business.

His pricing is reasonable and fair. Throughout the process, he was extremely responsive and gave frequent updates. He listened carefully to what we wanted and was always approachable and easy to work with.

The landscape design itself had a beautiful end-result. He has an artistic eye and took so much pride in every detail.

Beyond the quality of his work, what really stood out to us was how genuinely kind, honest, hardworking, and thoughtful he is.

We will be calling again for future projects!”

— Amy & Sourabh

I am not only a death doula. I am a doula of life.

I walk alongside souls as they enter this world, as they rebirth themselves while still living, and as they prepare to leave this physical experience.

Each passage is sacred.
Each one asks us to surrender what we thought we knew.
Each one reminds us how powerful it is simply to be present.

This last experience reminded me again that end-of-life work is never only about the person preparing to cross. It is about the entire family. It is holding space for the fear, the grief, the love, the questions, the silence—and all the words that can no longer be spoken aloud.

It is helping create peace around someone so they can feel safe, seen, and deeply loved through every breath.

And this work doesn’t begin only when someone is dying.

It can look like caregiving. Sitting beside someone. Listening to their stories. Helping them remember their purpose. Bringing laughter, dignity, connection, and life back into the days they still have here.

Because sometimes the greatest gift we can offer someone isn’t helping them prepare to leave…

It is helping them feel more alive while they are still here.

I have had the profound honor of walking beside so many through birth, rebirth, life, and death. Every experience has deepened my understanding that a doula does not lead the journey—we witness it, honor it, and help hold sacred space as each soul finds its own way.

If you or someone you love feels guided to have support through any of these passages, I would be honored to walk alongside you. 🫶🙏
